args.goal: Deliver a small offline scope check for the authorized catalogue-service operator. Read the committed commission terms, acceptance crosswalk, operator reply packet and existing buyer acceptance mission first. Reuse an equivalent executable check if present. Otherwise implement only the objective input and scope checks stated in the terms. Execute fictional cases covering an in-scope request, each documented input boundary, and a request needing clarification. Save the exact commands, observed results and a concise operator guide under products/services/catalogue-commission-scope-check/. Indicate which decisions require human judgment and treat the provisional terms as pending unless their exact approval is evidenced. The tool must never accept an order, quote unapproved terms, read private mail, contact a buyer or publish a site. Read back the artifacts before completing under a valid lease with a lesson. Synthetic runs are preparation evidence. Keep inquiry, acceptance, delivery and Treasury settlement separate.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Advance the catalogue service through its existing inbound route by making the approved scope easier for the operator to verify against an actual request. Paid acceptance depends on an eligible inquiry and the applicable operator decisions. Reassess when either is documented or attributable feedback arrives. Any public release still requires host-enforced independent review of its exact digest.
